RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. A numerical probability would be guesswork.

Your PhD and eight years’ leadership experience are substantial, but don’t establish that you best met every selection criterion. The successful candidate’s announcement may omit relevant experience.

Follow up your written request now. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and available review procedures and deadlines. Check whether any panel-composition policy applies.

Raise a discrimination concern if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria—not merely because the panel members were women. Legal rights and response deadlines depend on jurisdiction.
